flow-definition.description:
Mints new values for the four secrets the PIC-SURE services share, then redeploys every service that carries one. Rotating and redeploying are a single operation; there is no option to render without deploying.
Rotates: PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN, QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN and AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT, shared by gateway, operations and query. LOGGING_API_KEY, shared by gateway, visualization and pic-sure-logging.
BOTH STACKS ARE REDEPLOYED, including the one serving live traffic. LOGGING_API_KEY lives in configs/pic-sure-logging/logging.env, an object with no stack segment that every stack's deploy pulls, so a new key is presented by both stacks or by neither. Once the target stack is done, this job renders gateway.env, visualization.env and logging.env for the other stack, reading the key just minted back rather than minting a second one, and redeploys that stack's gateway, visualization and pic-sure-logging containers. Choosing the staging stack does not spare the live one.
During the run, expect on each stack a short window between the Wildfly deploy and the logging deploy where the gateway and visualization services already present the new key and pic-sure-logging still checks the old one. It answers those audit events with 401 and the logging client drops them. One key covers all three services, so the two sides cannot cut over at the same instant; the window is a cost of the single-key design rather than a defect. Reported aggregate counts also shift for queries run before and after, because AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT changed.
Why the redeploy is not optional: containers bake their env at create time, so a rotated QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN that no container has picked up leaves InternalTokenFilter rejecting the stale value with 403, which the gateway flattens into an opaque 500 on query downloads while every other endpoint keeps working. It takes two deploy calls because PIC-SURE Wildfly Stack Deploy has no DEPLOY_LOGGING parameter; pic-sure-logging deploys through PIC-SURE Logging Deploy.
Run this when a shared secret has been exposed, or when Render PIC-SURE Configuration aborts on a logging.env whose LOGGING_API_KEY is blank.
